items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Kenny Clarke on drums, and a bass player named Nick Penton.

ctx.x: Now, Klook Clarke was in this band at Minton's Playhouse. The band consisted of Monk on piano, Kermit Scott, tenor player, that's up in San Francisco now, Joe Guy on trumpet, Kenny Clarke on drums, and a bass player named Nick Penton. Now, Monk and Klook Clarke, they cooperated on these chords, because you see, Kenny Clarke, who was known as Klook Clarke, could play vibes, but he didn't have any vibes, you know. He had some bells. A little, small, compact thing, that he played bells occasionally. But he could…
* Jerry Newman. No, Dick Hecker - wire tape
